honest_c3: C1: Stage 1 mount layer not yet landed; dispatcher returns stage_1_pending until anima-core/runtime/clm_v4_mount.hexa exists. NO substrate forward executed in Stage 2 prep.
C2: substrate-response-as-metric is anima-internal heuristic; no external validation that phi-star + axis + cells form a coherent dialogue medium.

C3: session-log JSONL schema anima.dialogue.v1 is provisional — subject to revision once Stage 1 mount layer settles its emit format. Bash wrapper passes substrate emit verbatim, so mount.hexa decides the line content.

C4: REPL stdin loop is carried by bash wrapper (not hexa) because hexa exec() buffers stdin; each user line dispatches as a one-shot --probe to the mount. Implication: REPL loop is bash-only, hexa dispatcher only emits guidance for --interactive.
C5: phi_star_baseline 41.86 (paradigm v11 G3) hard-coded; if CLM v4 weights drift in future revisions, baseline must be re-loaded from config (not done in Stage 2 prep).
C6: dominant_cells thresholding heuristic deferred to Stage 1 mount layer; this stage emits whatever the mount returns.
C7: chat-capability is NOT promised by this dispatcher — spec §3 explicit substrate-coupled dialogue paradigm. Users expecting token emit will see substrate response only.

C8: session_summary aggregation uses awk regex over JSONL — fragile against schema drift; if mount.hexa emits a different field name for phi_star or phi_star_drift_pp the summary will under-count silently.
